name: Rubido
author: Davy Willems
description: Peg solitaire with four difficulties: jump pegs over each other to remove them until only one remains. Arrows and X to play, or mouse and touch.

descriptions.en: Peg solitaire with four difficulties: jump pegs over each other to remove them until only one remains. Arrows and X to play, or mouse and touch.
descriptions.it: Il solitario con i pioli in quattro difficoltà: salta un piolo sopra l'altro per eliminarlo finché ne resta uno solo. Frecce e X per giocare, oppure mouse o tocco.
